title: igiyoyi, launi, yadin da aka saka da gajerun layuka: ƙwarewa huɗu waɗanda ke siyarwa

say: igiyoyi, launi, yadin da aka saka da gajerun layuka: ƙwarewa huɗu waɗanda ke siyarwa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module biyu na Advanced Knitting da Crochet.
Wannan tsarin yana ƙara dabarun saƙa guda huɗu waɗanda ke juyar da masana'anta a fili zuwa samfuran da mutane ke gani. igiyoyi suna ba da rubutu. Launi yana ba da tsari.

say: Sanya stitches na gaba da ƙarfi daga allurar hagu, sa'an nan kuma kuɗa waɗanda ke cikin allurar USB, jawo zaren snug.

say: Rataya alamar a kan layin tsallaka, don haka za ku iya ƙidaya layuka zuwa mashigar gaba.
Ka tuna: giciye na gaba yana jingin hagu, giciye na baya yana karkata dama. Sanya C6B akan igiya ta hagu da C6F a dama, kuma suna madubi.
igiyoyi suna jawo masana'anta a ciki, don haka ko da yaushe swatch ƙirar kebul ɗin kanta.

say: Akwai hanyoyin launi guda uku. Yanki suna canza launi a farkon jere. Ɗauki zaren sama da gefe don ƙuƙuman ratsi, kuma yanke shi don masu fadi.

cards.d: Canja launi a farkon jere. Ɗauki yarn sama da gefe don kunkuntar ratsi, yanke shi don fadi.
Bobbin guda ɗaya don kowane shingen launi. Karkatar da tsohon da sabon zaren a kowane canji.
Launuka biyu a jere. Ci gaba da shawagi a kwance, kuma kama duk wani tafki mai tsayi fiye da kamar dinki 5.

say: Intarsia na manyan tubalan ne da haruffa. Kowane yanki na launi yana da nasa bobbin. A kowane canji, ɗauki sabon launi daga ƙarƙashin tsohuwar, don haka suna murɗawa kuma babu rami.

say: Saƙa da aka ɗaure yana amfani da launuka biyu a jere, kuma wanda ba a yi amfani da shi ba yana yawo a baya. Matsakaicin yawo a kan masana'anta. Kama duk wani mai iyo fiye da kusan dinki 5. Yakin da aka daskare yana da kauri biyu, don haka a cikin yanayin zafi yi amfani da shi don jaka da kayan haɗi.

say: Misali, Kemi a Legas tana son gyale mai tsayi mai tsayin santimita 160. Ma'aunin layinta shine layuka 30 a cikin 10 cm, don haka tana buƙatar layuka 480.

panel.heading: Kemi tana shirin zaren gyale
items: 160 cm x 3 layuka da cm = 480 layuka
Layukan 6 kowanne na A, B, C = 18 kowace maimaitawa
480/18 = 26.7, zagaye har zuwa 27
Kowane launi kamar 300 g / 3 = 100 g
Sayi ƙwallo 2 kowanne, da ƙari 1

say: Jerin ta shine layuka 6 kowanne daga cikin launuka uku, layuka 18 a kowane maimaitawa. 480 da aka raba ta 18 shine 26.7, don haka ta zagaye har zuwa 27 maimaitawa kuma ta ƙare akan cikakken tsiri.

say: Yadin da aka saka shi ne masana'anta tare da ramukan da aka sanya da gangan. Yarn a saman yana ƙara dinki kuma yana yin rami. k2tog ya cire daya ya jingina daidai. ssk ya cire daya ya jingina hagu.

say: Misali, Ruth a Abuja ta kirga daya maimaituwar gyalenta: zare, ssk, saƙa, k2tog, zaren sama, saƙa. Canjin gidan yanar gizon sifili ne, don haka stitches 47 nata suna tsayawa 47 har zuwa sama.
Kowane yarn a kan yana ƙara dinki, don haka haɗa shi da raguwa.

say: Rike waɗannan halaye. Kidaya dinki a kowane jere na gefen dama. Zare layin rayuwa kowane layuka 10 zuwa 20, don haka kuskure yana ɗaukar mintuna, ba kwanaki ba. Sa’ad da Ruth ta jefa zare a kan layi na 53, ta ja da baya kawai zuwa layin rayuwarta a jere na 40.
Sanya alama tsakanin maimaitawa, karanta ginshiƙi tare da mai mulki, kuma koyaushe toshe yadin da aka saka kafin ku yanke hukunci. Yadin da ba a toshe ya yi kama da murƙushewa.

say: A takaice jeri ne ba ka gama. Kuna juya da wuri kuma ku koma, don haka yanki ɗaya ya sami tsayi. Misali, Ifeoma a Enugu na bukatar tsayin kusan 5 cm sama da bust.

Yana juya kusan 4 stitches

say: Ma'aunin ta shine layuka 28 a cikin 10 cm. Sau 5 2.8 shine layuka 14. Kowace gajeriyar layuka tana ƙara layuka 2, don haka tana buƙatar nau'i-nau'i 7.

say: Ta baje juzu'ai kusan 4 daban, daga kowane gefen gefe, sannan ta yi aiki da cikakken jere ɗaya kowace hanya don ɓoye su. Yanzu kasan ta ya rataya matakin.
Dakatar da jujjuyawar kadan kafin bust point, ko dart na iya haifar da karo mai nuni.

say: Don tunawa. Giciye na gaba yana karkata hagu, giciye na baya yana karkata dama. Karkatar da yadudduka a kowane canjin intarsia. Kama dogayen iyo. Haɗa kowane zaren tare da raguwa. Kuma raba karin layuka da 2 don samun gajerun layuka na ku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Gicciyen gaba ya karkata zuwa hagu, baya ya karkata dama
Intarsia: karkatar da yadudduka a kowane canji
Kama yana shawagi fiye da kusan dinki 5
Haɗa kowane zaren tare da raguwa
Ƙarin layuka / 2 = nau'i-nau'i na gajerun layuka

say: Yanzu saƙa swatch na USB mai madubi, ɗigon ruwa da samfurin intarsia, ƙaramin samfurin yadin da aka toshe, da samfurin gajeriyar jeri tare da rubutaccen shirin dart. Hoton kowanne don fayil ɗin ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
